Product 01 — Closed Loop Maintenance

Closed Loop Maintenance

Real Flow Control. Real Industrial Skills.

Industrial PID Control Through Real-World Fault Finding Diagnose, Tune & Control Real Flow Systems From Flow Sensors to PID Controlled Valves

Real Industrial Hardware

Students can see and touch real industrial hardware from Siemens, IFM, Banner, Burkert, WAGO, TE Connectivity and more — not simulations.

Real Fault Insertion

Debug real faults inserted live during operation — sensor failures, incorrect parameters, unreachable setpoints. Students watch flow rates change and troubleshoot via the HMI, exactly as they would on-site.

Siemens Ecosystem

Featuring both a Siemens PLC and HMI. All code lives in one project file, fully adjustable via TIA Portal — completely open and available.

Lock Out Tag Out

A real industrial LOTO padlock and locking mechanism lets students physically shut off and lock out the industrial valve — gaining vital real-world experience at their desk.

Two Curriculums

One for beginners who've never heard of a PLC — walking through every component. A second for experienced students with realistic troubleshooting scenarios.

Dual PID Processes

Unlike traditional PLC trainers, students work with a real closed-loop flow control system. Dual PID loops control both the proportional valve and pump speed — tune parameters live and observe real-time changes in system behaviour and stability.

Safe 24V Operation

The entire system runs from a 24V DC SELV supply with no mains voltages — significantly safer for classrooms while still delivering real industrial maintenance experience.

Product 02 — PLC Fundamentals Trainer

PLC Fundamentals Trainer

Learn How Real Industrial Control Panels Work

Your First Step Into Industrial Automation Practical Training With PLCs, Relays, PT100 Sensors & Motors Real Industrial Hardware Built for Beginners

Real Industrial Hardware

Genuine components from Siemens, IFM, Omron, Banner, WAGO, ABB and more. Every button, relay, sensor and terminal reflects what learners will encounter in real electrical control panels.

Built Specifically for Beginners

Zero experience needed. Designed for students who have never opened a control panel. The curriculum starts with absolute fundamentals and builds confidence step-by-step through hands-on interaction.

12 Demo Programs

Both PLC and HMI programs included. The WinCC Unified HMI features 12 beautiful graphical demo programs for users to explore and learn from.

Maintenance Focused

Developed specifically for maintenance engineers and technicians — not software developers. The focus is on understanding hardware, signals, diagnostics and industrial behaviour.

Siemens Ecosystem

Featuring both a Siemens PLC and HMI. All code lives in one project file, fully adjustable via TIA Portal — completely open and available.

Lock Out Tag Out

A real industrial LOTO padlock and locking mechanism lets students physically shut off and lock out the industrial emergency stop — gaining vital real-world experience at their desk.

Learn Through Physical Interaction

Students don't just watch simulations. They press real buttons, trigger sensors, rotate potentiometers, monitor live PLC I/O, and observe motors and relays operating in real time.

Teaches More Than Just PLC Programming

Most beginner PLC trainers focus only on ladder logic. This system teaches the wider industrial maintenance picture — electrical panels, sensors, relays, analogue signals, safety circuits and troubleshooting.

Safe 24V Operation

The entire system runs from a 24V DC SELV supply with no mains voltages — significantly safer for classrooms while still delivering real industrial maintenance experience.

Product 03 — LOGO! Sense & Control

LOGO! Sense & Control — Industrial

Learn PLCs and Industrial Sensors with Locktronics & Siemens LOGO!

Custom Industrial Locktronics Powered by Siemens LOGO! Learn Industrial Sensors & Actuators Through Real PLC Control Discover Automation Through Hands-On Experimentation

Designed for Beginners

Ideal for learners taking their first steps into PLCs, automation and industrial control. Activities start with basic I/O before progressing into sequencing, analogue signals, PWM, fault detection and feedback control.

11 Practical Learning Activities

Structured experiments covering basic outputs, sequenced outputs, PWM, digital inputs, pedestrian crossing logic, potentiometers, sensors, fault detection, open-loop control and closed-loop control.

Maintenance-Focused Learning

Helps students understand signal behaviour, device operation, wiring, component limits, fault symptoms and how PLCs interact with field devices.

Simple Siemens Programming Workflow

Example programs transfer via the supplied USB stick and SD card reader. Advanced users can create or modify programs using Siemens LOGO! Soft Comfort.

Real Siemens LOGO! PLC Training

Students learn using a genuine Siemens LOGO! logic controller — real industrial PLC experience, not a simulated or simplified classroom-only controller.

Safe 24V Classroom Operation

Designed to operate from a 24V supply — suitable for classroom and workshop use while still giving students practical experience with industrial control concepts.

Built Around Locktronics

Combines Siemens LOGO! control with the Matrix Locktronics industrial sense and control range — students build real circuits using sensors, switches, relays, motors, lamps, potentiometers and actuator modules.

Build Custom Control Circuits

Students aren't limited to fixed front-panel exercises. They physically construct custom sensing and control circuits on the Locktronics baseboard — understanding how inputs, outputs, power, signals and loads are actually connected.
